stations.title: Perpetua
stations.say: A customer's statement is too high.
stations.note: The customer rang this morning. MF-14.

stations.title: The bank
stations.text: One order in September, one card payment.

captions: At Mallowfield Seeds, a customer rings Perpetua: the statement shows more than was paid.
The bank has one payment, but the statement adds it once for every line of her order.
You show the orders counted twice, then fix the statements and the stock check.
Now every statement shows each payment once, and every packet once.
Same orders, same payments. Every total counts each thing once.
